bremsstrahlung.paragraph: The prototype uses Bethe–Heitler energy sharing with the Butcher–Messel screening-function approximation. Its electron-electron factor uses a Z-dependent Coulomb correction in its radiation logarithm (SLAC-R-730, section 2.7; implemented in bremsstrahlung_p3r.py). Its total is renormalized to ESTAR radiative stopping power. EGS5 additionally uses its aprime.data correction to the bremsstrahlung shape; the prototype does not use this research-only table. Normalization to the same stopping power constrains the energy integral and does not establish the differential spectrum for Z=82. P8a records this limitation: its screening branch has no full high-Z Coulomb subtraction. Generating material-specific bremsstrahlung tables and testing the lead spectrum belong to P8b. Source: https://www.slac.stanford.edu/pubs/slacreports/reports16/slac-r-730.pdf ; local source: prototypes/mv_electron/bremsstrahlung_p3r.py and docs/egs5_crosscheck/egs5/pegs/pegs5.f (BREMDZ, FCOULC, APRIM).
